Santa Special Delivery label and North Pole stamp (printed or drawn)
Knitted elf hat and scarf (optional)
Paper and marker for the sign

2026-11-28.materials:
Matching holiday pajamas
Festive headbands
Train-ride tickets (real or printed)
Sign

2026-11-29.materials:
Toy pool or small dish
Big marshmallows
Reindeer or other plush friend
Paper sign

2026-11-30.materials:
Rolls of tablet candy
Glass bowl and spoon
Sign

Popped popcorn
Jar of corn kernels
Small glass bowl
Small whiteboard

2026-12-04.materials:
A kid's notebook
Multicolor pen (red and green)

2026-12-07.materials:
Doll-size table and chairs
A red and a green candy cane (warm them to bend)
Tiny cake or treats
A printed page of math problems for each kid

2026-12-08.materials:
Mason jar

Paper sign

2026-12-11.materials:
Two mugs filled with sugar
Small white mints (the seeds)
Paper sign

2026-12-12.materials:
The sugar mugs from night 1
Mini candy canes
Paper sign

Painter's tape for the target
Paper scoreboard

Fish-shaped crackers

welcome-back.title: Special delivery from the North Pole
welcome-back.alt: An elf in a knitted red-and-white striped hat pokes out of a hole in a mail envelope, one arm reaching out. The envelope is labeled Santa Special Delivery with a North Pole postmark, and a handwritten note reads: Let me back inside!!! It's cold out here.
supplies: Santa Special Delivery label and North Pole stamp (printed or drawn)
Paper and marker for the sign
welcome-back.setup: Cut a hole near the top of a big mail envelope. Tuck the elf inside so the head and one arm poke out, as if they mailed themselves home. Add a Santa Special Delivery label and a North Pole stamp, and tape the sign beside the elf. Leave it by the front door or on the doormat.
signs: LET ME BACK INSIDE!!! It's cold out here!
Special delivery! I mailed myself home!
We're BACK!! We missed you SO much!

ice-fishing.title: Ice fishing for crackers
ice-fishing.alt: A tiny wooden fishing pole with a wooden fish, still in its bag.
ice-fishing.setup: Cover a bowl with foil, poke a hole in the middle, and put fish crackers inside. The elves fish through the hole.
signs: Gone fishin'! 🎣
We caught breakfast! (Crackers only)
Ice fishing at the North Pole… we mean the kitchen.

elf-curling.title: Elf curling
elf-curling.alt: A small straw broom held in one hand.
elf-curling.setup: Tape a target on the hallway floor or a counter. Marshmallows are the stones. Pose the elves mid-sweep and post a scoreboard.
signs: Elf Curling Championship! Score: 3 to 4
SWEEP! SWEEP! Who wins the rematch?
Winter Elf Games: curling day!

grocery-run.title: Elf grocery run
grocery-run.alt: A mini paper grocery bag with handles and a red tag that says gummy candy.
supplies: Mini paper grocery bag of gummy candy
Paper and marker for a tiny shopping list
grocery-run.setup: The elves come home from the store with a mini grocery bag. Unpack a few gummies on the counter like tiny groceries, with a little shopping list beside them.
signs: We went grocery shopping! Guess what we bought? 🛒
Shopping list: gummies, gummies, MORE gummies.
Elf-sized groceries for elf-sized snacks!

candy-cane-doors.title: Candy-cane doors (FaceTime)
candy-cane-doors.alt: A box of red, green and white foam candy-cane stickers.
candy-cane-doors.setup: While the kids are at the other home, the elves cover the bedroom doors in candy-cane stickers. Show a quick peek on the call and save the full reveal.
candy-cane-doors.story: We got bored without you, so we decorated your doors! You'll see the rest when you get home.
signs: We decorated while you were gone! 🍭
Candy canes EVERYWHERE!

drank-too-fast.title: Drank too fast
drank-too-fast.setup: Push one elf head-first into an empty water bottle so only the legs stick out. The baby elf sits nearby looking worried.
signs: I was so thirsty but I think I drank too fast!
Help! I'm stuck in the bottle!
Stay hydrated, kids. Just not like this.

poop-corn.title: Poop-corn party
poop-corn.alt: An elf lounges in scattered popcorn next to an open jar of corn kernels. A baby elf peeks out of a glass bowl, and a whiteboard sign asks if you'd like some poop-corn.
poop-corn.setup: Scatter popcorn around an open jar of kernels. One elf lounges in the mess with a hand in the jar; the baby elf hides in a glass bowl. Write the sign on a small whiteboard.
signs: Happy Day 2 of December! Would you like to try some of my poop-corn to celebrate?
Fresh poop-corn! Help yourself!
We made a snack. Don't ask why it's called poop-corn.

tea-party-math.title: Tea party with math problems
tea-party-math.alt: An elf sits at a tiny white tea table with a pink cake, marshmallow treats, and a red and a green candy cane bent into a 6 and a 7. A baby elf with a pacifier sits in a pink chair.
supplies: A red and a green candy cane (warm them to bend)
A printed page of math problems for each kid
tea-party-math.setup: Set up a tiny tea party. Bend a red and a green candy cane into a 6 and a 7 on the table. Leave each kid a page of elf-themed math problems at their grade level (candy canes hidden, jingle bells found).
signs: Here are some 6-7 math problems!
Tea party time! Can you solve our math problems?
Elf school is in session! Pencils ready!

candy-cereal.title: Candy cereal breakfast
candy-cereal.setup: Unwrap a pile of tablet candies into a bowl like cereal, spoon in. Leave the empty wrappers everywhere.
signs: Yummy! I love my candy cereal for breakfast!
Part of a balanced elf breakfast!
We ate breakfast without you. Sorry not sorry!

brush-itch.title: The itchy-bottom brush
brush-itch.alt: An elf upside down in a glass mason jar with only its hat and legs sticking out, a blue brush handle beside it, on a wood floor by a window.
brush-itch.setup: Tuck an elf upside down in a mason jar with a clean brush sticking out beside him.
signs: Had a butt itch. Thanks for letting me use the butt brush!
Don't ask. Just don't.
Itch: solved.

pea-d-pants.title: Pea-d in the pants
pea-d-pants.alt: In an empty bathtub, an elf sits in a blue toy boat. Next to it, a pair of brown pants holds a small bowl of green peas. A handwritten sign is taped to the tub wall.
pea-d-pants.setup: Set a bowl of peas inside a pair of grown-up pants. The elf sits nearby in a toy boat in the empty bathtub.
signs: I came upstairs! Do you like my hiding place? I also "pea-d" in your Mommy's pants! Hahaha
Oops, I pea-d!
Peas excuse me!

marshmallow-swim.title: Marshmallow swim
marshmallow-swim.alt: In an empty white bathtub, an elf lies in a toy pool filled with big marshmallows under a thatched toy umbrella, next to a reindeer plush in a knit scarf. The sign says Went swimming!!!
marshmallow-swim.setup: In the empty bathtub, lay the elf in a toy pool full of marshmallows under a little umbrella, with a reindeer friend lounging beside it.
signs: Went swimming!!!
The water is fine! (It's marshmallows.)
Pool party at the North Pole!

reindeer-golf.title: Reindeer golf
supplies: Small toy house or cup for the hole
reindeer-golf.setup: Set up a mini golf hole on a counter. The elf takes a swing while the reindeer caddies.
signs: FORE!
Hole in one! (Not really.)
Practicing for the North Pole Open.

elf-pets.title: Elf pets and tic-tac-toe
elf-pets.setup: Draw a tic-tac-toe grid with candy-cane lines. Red and green bows are the X's and O's. The elf's new pets watch the game.
signs: I got my own elf pets. Please don't touch or they will lose their power!!
Meet our new pets! Look, don't touch!
Who wants to play the winner?

train-day.title: Holiday train day
train-day.setup: On the morning of a holiday outing, the elves deliver matching pajamas and headbands for each kid with the tickets laid out in front.
signs: We're going to the North Pole on the train today. Take me with you!!!
All aboard! Pajamas required!
Tickets? Check. Pajamas? Check. Elves? Coming too!

cake-decorating.title: Cake decorating
cake-decorating.alt: An elf sits at a tiny green bakery table with two mini cakes covered in sprinkles, next to a toy mixing bowl and rolling pin. The sign says I wanted to decorate some cakes too!!
supplies: Two small treats (brownie bites or crispy-rice squares)
cake-decorating.setup: Set the elf at a tiny table with two small treats on parchment, sprinkles scattered on top, and a toy bowl and rolling pin beside it. Good for a night after the family bakes.
signs: I wanted to decorate some cakes too!!
Elf bakery is open!
I saved you a cake. Maybe.

where-are-you.title: Where are you?
where-are-you.alt: A notebook page with red and green letters reading Rudy was here, where are you? A baby elf and a snowman pen sit on the page.
where-are-you.setup: While the kids are at the other home, an elf writes in one of their notebooks, alternating red and green letters, and leaves the pen on the page. On the FaceTime call, the elves can ask where everyone went.
signs: {elf} was here. Where are you?
We missed you! Come back soon!
We looked everywhere for you!
where-are-you.story: We looked all over the house for you, then wrote in your notebook!

ceiling-hang.title: Hanging from the ceiling
ceiling-hang.alt: An elf hangs upside down from a white ceiling by its feet, arms out, above an arched nook. The sparkly starburst topper of a lit Christmas tree glows below.
supplies: Removable poster putty or adhesive hooks
ceiling-hang.setup: Stick the elf's feet to the ceiling with removable putty so it hangs upside down above the Christmas tree. No sign needed.
signs: Just hanging around!
The view is great from up here!
Don't tell Santa I'm upside down.
ceiling-hang.story: We got bored without you, so we tried hanging from the ceiling!

early-present.title: An early present
early-present.alt: An elf holds a handwritten sign that says 7 days until Christmas, here is an early present for being good. Two small holiday toys, a gingerbread man and a Christmas tree, lie at its feet.
early-present.setup: The elf sits holding a countdown sign with a small present for each kid laid at its feet. Change the number to match the night.
signs: 4 days until Christmas! (Here is an early present for being good)
Santa said you've been extra good!
A little something before the big day!

magic-garden-seeds.title: Magic garden, night 1: plant the seeds
magic-garden-seeds.alt: An elf sits between two white mugs filled with sugar, with two small white mints on the table. The sign says Magic garden! Put these seeds in sugar and wait 1 day!!
magic-garden-seeds.setup: Fill a mug with sugar for each kid and leave a mint 'seed' beside each. The kids plant them in the morning. Follow with the sprouts night, then swap in big candy canes for the fully grown plant.
signs: Magic garden! Put these seeds in sugar and wait 1 day!!
Plant a seed, grow a candy cane!
Elf gardening class starts now.

magic-garden-sprouts.title: Magic garden, night 2: sprouts
magic-garden-sprouts.alt: An elf sits between two white mugs of sugar, each with a small candy cane sprouting from it. The sign says Wait one more day and the magic plant will be all grown.
magic-garden-sprouts.setup: Take out the mints and push a mini candy cane into each mug of sugar so it looks like a sprout. On the next night, swap them for full-size candy canes.
signs: Wait one more day and the magic plant will be all grown!
They're sprouting!
Almost ready to pick!

tree-swing.title: Swinging in the tree
tree-swing.alt: An elf sits on a swing made from a toilet paper tube hanging in a lit Christmas tree, holding a sign that says Thanks for the push, next to a gray teddy bear.
tree-swing.setup: Hang a toilet paper tube from a sturdy branch with string to make a swing. Sit the elf on it with a plush friend nearby who 'pushed' it.
signs: Thanks for the push!
Wheee! Higher!
Best seat in the tree!

wicker-baskets.name: Two-basket carrier
wicker-baskets.alt: Small two-basket wicker carrier with braided handles

candy-cane-stickers.name: Foam candy-cane stickers
candy-cane-stickers.alt: Box of red, green and white foam candy-cane stickers

fishing-pole.name: Mini wooden fishing pole
fishing-pole.alt: Tiny wooden fishing pole and wooden fish in a bag

mini-grocery-bag.name: Mini grocery bag of gummies
mini-grocery-bag.alt: Mini paper grocery bag of gummy candy
